ArtifactFolder.description:
A folder of the project that holds stored artifacts (SPEC-0001, Where artifacts live).

- `plan_briefs`: The folder `plan/briefs`: briefs, `BRIEF-<seq>.yaml`.
- `plan_council`: The folder `plan/council`: council reports, `COUNCIL-<seq>.yaml`.
- `plan_items`: The folder `plan/items`: plan items before their tracker item exists.
- `specs`: The folder `specs`: living specifications, `<NNNN>-<capability>/spec.md`.

BaseStatus.description: The status of one artifact of the set on the default branch.

status.description: Its status on the default branch.

DocumentEntry.description: One stored artifact or input. `format` chooses which other members are given: `document` (with `lines` for a file), `markdown` (with `text`), `unreadable` (with `error`, and a `file` origin: only a file can fail to parse).

error.description: With the format `unreadable`: what the parser reported.

input_kind.description: With the format `document`, for an input; absent for an artifact.

lines.description: With the format `document` and a file origin: where each value is in the file.

origin.description: Where the document was read; it becomes `source` in every error. Absent for a document sent directly.

text.description: With the format `markdown`: the content of the file.

EntryFormat.description:
What an entry of `documents` holds; it chooses which other members are given.

- `document`: A JSON value in the normalised form of its type, in `document`, with `lines` for a file.
- `markdown`: The text of a living specification (`spec.md`), in `text`.
- `unreadable`: A file that did not parse, with what the parser reported in `error`.

FreeDocument.description: A document in the normalised form of its type, checked by the schema of its kind.

InputKind.description:
Type of an input (SPEC-0001, Inputs), which has no `kind` member.

- `pull_request`: A pull request: title, body, branch and labels.
- `commit`: A commit message: header and body.
- `handover_input`: A hand-over submitted by an agent, before the engine fills its own fields.

additionalProperties.description: Line of a file, counted from 1.

Lines.description: The line, from 1, of each value of the document, keyed by its RFC 6901 pointer into the document.

Origin.description: Where a document was read: exactly one of `file`, `issue`, `milestone`, which the core checks. The member present tells the form, with no tag, as for `source` of an error: a choice without a kind, against the letter of ADR 0009 C4, so that the input and the error report write a place the same way (plan of SPEC-0001).

file.description: Path of the file relative to the root of the project.

issue.description: A tracker issue, by its number.

milestone.description: A tracker milestone, by its number.

ParseError.description: What the parser of a file reported when it could not read it.

line.description: Line of the fault, counted from 1.

message.description: Message of the parser, for a person.

Pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON pointer; its root is stated where it is used. Empty for the whole value, or a sequence of `/`-prefixed reference tokens in which `~` is written `~0` and `/` is written `~1`. It serialises as its string.

Policy.description: The subset of the project policy the artifact model reads (SPEC-0021 R1): the types and scopes of commits and the areas of epics and tasks.

areas.description: Areas of epics and tasks, without the `area:` prefix.

items.description: A name of the project policy, an identifier rather than prose: a type of commits, a scope or an area, spelt as the policy spells it, of at least one character.

scopes.description: Scopes of commits and pull request titles.

items.description: A name of the project policy, an identifier rather than prose: a type of commits, a scope or an area, spelt as the policy spells it, of at least one character.

types.description: Types of commits, branches and pull request titles.

items.description: A name of the project policy, an identifier rather than prose: a type of commits, a scope or an area, spelt as the policy spells it, of at least one character.

Status.description:
Status of an artifact (SPEC-0001 R5), as any type allows it.

- `draft`: Written, not approved.
- `approved`: Approved by a person.
- `surveyed`: A specification written by the survey of an existing project, not approved.
- `implementing`: Work on it has started.
- `done`: Delivered; terminal.
- `superseded`: Replaced by other artifacts; terminal.

description: The canonical input of `wayloop validate`: a set of stored artifacts and inputs, validated together in one pass. A member set to null is not given (ADR 0009 C2). Checks whose part of the engine is not built yet are listed in `diagnostics.not_done` of the result.

adrs.description: Numbers of the ADRs of the project, for the check `adr_citations`: the warning on a citation `ADR <NNNN>` with no ADR of that number. Absent: citations are not checked, and the check is listed in `diagnostics.not_done` with the reason `input_absent`.

items.description: Number of an ADR of the project, from 1.

base.description: Statuses on the default branch of the artifacts of this set, for the checks of transitions and initial statuses (SPEC-0001 R13, R19). Absent: those checks are not done.

documents.description: One entry per stored artifact or input, in the order the caller sorted them; `[]` means none. Errors of documents are reported in this order.

language.description: Language of the project: the language of the prose of a document without its own `language`. When it is absent and a check needs it, the default is listed in `meta.defaults_applied`; no check of this version reads it.

locations.description: The folders of stored artifacts that exist in the project, when the documents were discovered there (SPEC-0001 R26). Empty: none exists, for example because the command did not run at the root of the project, which is reported as a warning. Absent: the documents were named or sent directly, and the check is not done. Their order and a repeated folder have no meaning, and the folders are not compared with the `file` origins of the documents.

policy.description: The subset of the project policy. Absent: the default policy applies.
